capabilities: Browse all vault images in a grid gallery (PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, SVG)
Drag images from the gallery directly into notes
Detect added, renamed, or deleted images in real time
extras: Freemium: the free plugin covers browsing, search, and drag-and-drop, while a paid 'Media Atlas Pro' version (sold on Gumroad) adds an unused-media cleaner and other premium tools. The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and offers manual installation labeled 'Beta'.
problem: Obsidian has no visual grid for browsing and inserting the images stored in a vault, so users must find and reference media by typing paths manually.
summary: Visual media gallery that lets you browse, search, and drag vault images into notes.
